environment.headline: retime's 'silence-separated event' detection is LITERAL DIGITAL ZEROS (source: ibuf[i]==0.0, no threshold, no configurability) - a run of >= minsil ms of exact zeros. Real recordings with a noise floor are ONE event. No-silence behavior differs by mode: 1 needs no detection (user refpoints); 4/5 warn 'only 1 event found' + near-passthrough; 3/6/7/8/9/10 refuse 'NO SILENCE-GAPS FOUND IN FILE.' peakfind->clicknew round-trip verified sample-tight (clicks within 2 samples of each peakfind time).

entries.duration_row_reason: Requires the refpoints aux datafile the shared single-input duration fixture cannot supply (grain rerhythm/reposition precedent). Duration is data-dependent: fits first_ref + (n-1)*beat + (indur - last_ref) on the event fixture at 2 tempi (2.09/3.59) but not on flat noise (segments truncate on collision); duration_model expression 'refpoints' engages the aux-param preflight skip (submix mix precedent).
notes: Mode 1 needs NO silence detection - user supplies peak times; works on any material (flat noise verified). Events aligned by PEAK onto first_ref + k*beat grid.

refpoints is a required datafile (scalar refused 'Failed to open file 0.3 for input.'); >= 2 ascending times ('TOO FEW ENTERED TIMES (MUST BE AT LEAST 2).', 'TIME (0.500000) OUT OF SEQUENCE OR INVALID'); times past EOF discarded before the count check.

tempo (0 to 400) + runtime rule 'Output tempo vals must be > 0 AND less than 1 (beat duration) OR >= 20 (MM)'; DUAL-UNIT VERIFIED BYTE-EXACT: tempo 0.5 (beat secs) == tempo 120 (MM). tempo brk refused (parameter 1).
Deterministic (1.2 s-apart pair identical; retime.c has no rand anywhere); stereo accepted -> any.

entries.duration_row_reason: Flat-noise fixture refused 'NO SILENCE-GAPS FOUND IN FILE.' (mode 3 uses the refusing count_events path, unlike 4/5). Real rule exact on 3 probes: outdur = last_event_onset + (outevwidth + splicelen)/1000; static declared as the safe baseline (actual <= indur + 1.001 always).
notes: Shorten events IN PLACE: onsets unchanged, each event cut to outevwidth(+splice), trailing silence dropped ('INFO: 4 of 4 events will be shortened').
inevwidth/outevwidth/splicelen (1.000000 to 1000.000000) Parameters 2/3/4; minsil (0.045351 to 10000.000000); all 4 refuse brks (parameters 1-4).
Deterministic; stereo accepted.

Event onsets placed at lead_silence + k*beat; duration = lead + (n-1)*beat + last_event_len, 4-dp exact on 5 probes (2 fixtures, 3 tempi incl. beat-dur form). Zero-run proof at beat 1.0: onsets 0.05/1.05/2.05/3.05.

NO-SILENCE MATERIAL: exit 0 with 'WARNING: WARNING: only 1 event found: Change inter-event silence ??' and near-passthrough (1.9999773 s from 2.0, one frame short, max residual 3.5e-4) - the duration row rides this path.

tempo (0 to 6000) + '>0 AND less than 1 OR >= 20' runtime rule; minsil (0.045351 to 10000.000000) P2; pregain (0 to 1) P3, 0 refused 'Pregain parameter of zero, will produce silent output.' All 3 refuse brks (parameters 1-3).
Deterministic; stereo accepted (1.97 s 2ch matches mono).

Inter-onset intervals scaled by 1/factor, event content untouched: factor 2 -> onsets 0.05/0.375/0.675/1.025 (1.445 exact); factor 0.5 -> 4.37 exact; ev3 -> 1.025 exact. Duration = lead + (last_onset - first_onset)/factor + last_len (data-dependent; static row rides the flat-noise warn+passthrough path).
factor BREAKPOINT-CAPABLE (banner-confirmed 'can vary over time'): brk 0.5->2 -> 2.057 s, differs from both scalar endpoints. minsil brk refused (parameter 2).
factor (0.010000 to 100.000000); factor 1 refused 'No change in tempo.'; -s start (0 to indur) runtime-quoted; -s/-e zone and -a sync verified live (renders + durations change).
Deterministic; stereo accepted. WATCHDOG NOTE: factor 0.01 on wide-spaced events can expand duration ~100x past the static prediction - engine cap is the guard.

notes: Events positioned at offset + beat_k * beatdur (swing file 0/1.5/2/3 @120 -> onsets 0.2/0.95/1.2/1.7, verified by zero runs).

DATAFILE-COUNT CONTRACT (contrast grain reposition's silent drop): fewer entries than events REFUSED 'Found 4 events, but only 2 out-event-beat-placements specified.'; more entries -> WARNING + surplus ignored.
tempo (0.010000 to 1000.000000) P2; offset (0 to 1000) P3; pregain ~0 refused 'Pregain is (effectively) zero: output will be silence.'; tempo/minsil/pregain refuse brks (parameters 1/3/4).
Deterministic (pair verified); stereo accepted.

notes: Events positioned at offset + time_k seconds (times 0/0.4/0.8/1.6 offset 0.2 -> onsets 0.2/0.6/1.0/1.8 verified; outdur 2.22 = 1.8 + 0.42).

entries.duration_row_reason: Flat-noise fixture refused 'NO SILENCE-GAPS FOUND IN FILE.' Duration genuinely static (sample-exact) on all event-fixture probes.
notes: METER path exact: -m3 scales unaccented events to exactly evening x accent level (peaks 0.204/0.68 = 0.3 at evening 0.3).

EVENING (meter 0) PATH CLIPS (first-class): evening 1 on event gains 1.0/0.3/0.6/0.15 drives peaks to 1.0/3.35/1.43/6.45 - up to 6.4x OVER full scale in the float output, no warning, no headroom management.

entries.duration_row_reason: Arity-0 with duration driven by the clicktimes aux datafile (outdur = last time + ~21-sample click tail); duration_model expression 'clicktimes' engages the aux-param preflight skip (submix mix precedent).
notes: ROUND-TRIP WITH PEAKFIND VERIFIED: peakfind's .txt fed verbatim as clicktimes renders clicks whose onsets sit within 2 samples of each peakfind time (4/4). Formats directly compatible; clicknew additionally allows ';' comment lines (verified).

BANNER SRATE LIST FALSE (first-class): banner lists 8 rates (88200 twice); enforced = range gate (44100.000000 to 96000.000000) THEN LEGAL_SRATE {16000,24000,22050,32000,44100,48000} (globcon.h:94) - 88200/96000 refused 'Illegal Sampling Rate.' Intersection: ONLY 44100 and 48000.

CLOCK-SEEDED CLICK SHAPE, UNSEEDABLE (first-class): generate_clicktable() calls initrand48() (= srand(time(0)), osbind.c) + drand48 in the waveshape; no seed slot. Runs > 1.2 s apart differ in samples (same duration); same-second runs byte-identical (collision trap). TIMES deterministic, SHAPE jitters.

Datafile: ascending >= 0 times, but the check RESETS PER LINE (source lasttime=-1.0 inside the fgets loop): newline-separated non-ascending times ACCEPTED, render silently truncates at the out-of-order point ('1.0\n0.5\n' -> 0.50 s output); same values on one line refuse 'Times do not advance at time ...'. Max time 32767 ('Maximum time is excessive : 40000.000000'); 32766 ACCEPTED -> ~1.9 GB render - engine duration cap is the only guard.
Output mono; clicks ~18 samples wide, peak ~0.96; single-time file works (0.5 -> 0.5005 s).
Crescendo sort verified: output RMS thirds 0.037/0.065/0.161 rising (mode 2 is the exact mirror 0.161/0.065/0.037 - execute() sibling; modes 3/4 accel/rit run with same duration, distinct shas).
esiz 0 = individual wavesets (verified, closer-to-input duration 2.419 from 2.5). esiz (0.000000 to 2000.000000); too big -> 'Elementsize too big for infile. (If meant to be frq, set flag).'

Duration static-with-losses: flat noise -2.4% (row); event material -7.9%; worst -22% on a fixture with long tail silence (element quantization + silence folding). Honest bounds in entry known_issues.

Random element order, seed positional. BANNER FALSE (first-class): 'Zero seed-value gives different random ordering on each run' - source is 'if(mode==RAND && seed > 0) srand(seed)', so seed 0 never seeds and glibc's default state == srand(1). Verified: seed 0 twice 1.3 s apart BYTE-IDENTICAL and equal to seed 1. No clock path; sorter is always reproducible; distinct-seed space 1-256.
seed 42 twice 1.2 s apart byte-identical; 42 vs 43 differ. seed (0.000000 to 256.000000) P2; seed brk refused ('Cannot read parameter 2').
Same duration behavior/ranges/mono-only as submode 1 (2.3023 from 2.5 at esiz 0.1 on the event fixture; -2.4% on flat noise).
